limits: Static semantic audit only. No unit, component, integration, full-suite, build, or browser test execution is claimed.

No paid model calls, external MCP, credential-bearing browser session, production endpoint, live OAuth flow, public HTTPS deployment, real model turn, remote execution, PTY interaction, microphone/WebRTC or external service action was performed.

UI rendering, accessibility and responsive behavior were checked in source rather than a running browser. Native runtime, transport and deployment integrations require their separately authorized later verification.

Test bodies outside the explicitly listed full-body files were reviewed through all contracts/assertions/hooks and helper/fixture code, with separately assigned supplemental full-body coverage attributed to its own reviewers.

methodDetails.independence: Fresh review of the frozen current source. No historical audit reports, outcomes, historical source, or sibling review findings were used. Current contract documents were used as requirements, with their historical claims treated only as dated provenance. Supplemental reviewers are separately attributed below and are not claimed as this reviewer's full-body work.
methodDetails.timing: startedAt is the timestamp captured by this reviewer's initial fresh hash/AST scan. Review and seal timestamps are independently generated during this round.
methodDetails.production: Read all production TS/TSX bodies, JSX and hooks semantically, including effects, cleanup, dependency/identity ownership, A-to-B-to-A transitions, authentication expiry, explicit action/consent gates, draft retention and revision acknowledgements, receipt recovery and no automatic mutation replay. Followed related API, reducer, schema, storage, media, OAuth, workflow, terminal, file and Git call chains.
methodDetails.otherSources: Read every assigned style, configuration, HTML and current web verification document, plus the complete preview server helper. Reviewed responsive/hidden/inert/focus behavior, static configuration, fixture allowlists, request limits, path containment, listener ownership and teardown. Historical verification statements were not reused as current evidence.

tests.contractMethod: Fresh AST extraction of every describe/it/test contract, all assertion call chains rooted in expect/assert, and complete before/after hooks; all extracted entries were semantically read. Separately extracted and read every non-import, non-test, non-hook fixture/helper/mock declaration, including declarations nested in describe callbacks. This was not a title/count-only inspection.
tests.fullBodyMethod: Additionally read the complete AST-selected test callback source in the 30 files below, covering security boundaries, media decoding, approval forms, ownership/async races, draft acknowledgements, auth recovery and operation recovery. Other tests received the complete contract/hook/helper review described above; their unlisted test-body scaffolding is not claimed as a full-body review.
tests.supplementAttribution: Assignments and report paths are coordination metadata only. This reviewer did not use supplemental findings as independent evidence. The round coordinator must check each separate artifact before claiming its added full-body coverage.
